fields.label: Show bar button
fields.description: Show the KDE Connect helper in the bar.

fields.label: Bar placement
fields.description: Place the button at the leading or trailing side of either bar orientation.

fields.label: Button appearance
fields.description: Choose a compact or detailed bar button.

fields.label: Button content
fields.description: Choose the information shown beside the phone icon.

fields.label: Preferred device
fields.description: Use auto or select a device from the popup. Device identifiers are stored here.

fields.label: Primary click action
fields.description: Open the helper popup or the official KDE Connect interface.

fields.label: Battery display
fields.description: Choose how battery information appears inside the bar button.

fields.label: Polling interval
fields.description: Seconds between status checks while the daemon is running, from 5 to 300.

fields.label: Hide when disconnected
fields.description: Hide the button when no paired device is connected, while keeping recovery states visible.

fields.label: Hide KDE Connect tray icon
fields.description: Hide the separate KDE Connect status icon from the system tray.

fields.label: Battery ring thickness
fields.description: Set the battery progress outline width from 1 to 6 pixels.

fields.label: Battery ring color
fields.description: Enter a hexadecimal color such as #66bb6a.

fields.label: Low battery threshold
fields.description: Use the low battery color at or below this percentage.

fields.label: Low battery color
fields.description: Enter a hexadecimal color such as #66bb6a.

fields.label: Warning battery threshold
fields.description: Use the warning color at or below this percentage.

fields.label: Warning battery color
fields.description: Enter a hexadecimal color such as #fbc02d.
